comparison_method: Per-episode values come from AuditKit (ak.evaluate with model='precomputed' and custom scorers). Confidence intervals are a percentile paired bootstrap over tasks (frugal_analyst.metrics.paired_bootstrap_ci), because AuditKit 1.1.11 has no confidence interval. ak.compare(...).significance() adds AuditKit's own paired bootstrap p-value. ak.compare_models cannot take a different precomputed output per model, so it is not used.
